mapper.select: select count(user_id) + count(resource_type) + count(resource_id) + count(granted_by) + count(granted_at) from tinc_resource_grant where 1 = 0
select count(*) from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select user_id from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' for update

select count(*) from tinc_network n join tinc_server s on s.Id = n.server_id where n.id = #{id} and exists (select 1 from tinc_resource_grant g where g.user_id = #{userId} and ((g.resource_type = 'SERVER' and g.resource_id = n.server_id) or (g.resource_type = 'NETWORK' and g.resource_id = n.id)))

select count(*) from tinc_node d join tinc_network n on n.id = d.network_id join tinc_server s on s.Id = n.server_id where d.id = #{id} and exists (select 1 from tinc_resource_grant g where g.user_id = #{userId} and ((g.resource_type = 'SERVER' and g.resource_id = n.server_id) or (g.resource_type = 'NETWORK' and g.resource_id = n.id)))
select g.resource_id from tinc_resource_grant g join tinc_server s on s.Id = g.resource_id where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.resource_type = 'SERVER' order by g.resource_id

select g.resource_id from tinc_resource_grant g join tinc_network n on n.id = g.resource_id join tinc_server s on s.Id = n.server_id where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.resource_type = 'NETWORK' order by g.resource_id
select Id as id, server_name as serverName from tinc_server order by Id
select n.id, n.network_name as networkName, n.server_id as serverId, s.server_name as serverName from tinc_network n join tinc_server s on s.Id = n.server_id order by n.id
select count(*) from tinc_server where Id = #{id}
select count(*) from tinc_network n join tinc_server s on s.Id = n.server_id where n.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into tinc_resource_grant (user_id, resource_type, resource_id, granted_by) values (#{userId}, #{type}, #{id}, #{grantedBy})
